### Changed
- **`gemma-4-31b` serves 32k on one L40S: `--kv-cache-dtype=fp8` with `--max-model-len=32768` (was 8k)** (giantswarm/agent-platform#611). With vLLM's bf16 KV cache the 48 GB card held 8640 tokens beside the 31 GiB of weights. The fp8 cache halves the need: on one L40S (g6e.2xlarge) with vLLM 0.23.0 the preset reached Ready with 49,885 tokens of KV cache (1.5 full-length requests at a time) and served tool calls through the gemma4 parser.
